6/60, sign in front
rules: count the negatives
a minus below the line means the same as one in front
then divide both by what they share
visual.hint: How many negatives are there, and where do they end up?

problems.explain: One negative, and it does not matter which line it is on — 6/−60 means the same as −6/60, because dividing by a negative and taking the negative of a division come to the same thing. Then 6 and 60 share a factor of 6, leaving −1/10.
